title: Customer Service
description: About Us We are an innovative technology services provider supporting more than 8,000 clients across telecoms and media services, with specialisms in website design, SEO, PPC, and virtual number/VoIP solutions. title: Customer Service Advisor
company: Red Snapper Recruitment Limited - Agency - Contract
description: RSR is a public safety & enterprise security recruitment specialist. We assist public safety employers find the right talent. We assist all employers when they want to source public safety and enterprise security skills and experience. Customer Service Advisor Location: Fareham, Hampshire Contract: Full-Time, Contract (6 Months) Pay Rate: 14.10 per hour Join a Professional Customer Service Team We are currently recruiting for a Customer Service Advisor to join a busy and customer-focused organisation based in Fareham. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced customer service professional who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and delivering a high standard of service in a fast-paced environment. As the first point of contact for members of the public, partner agencies, and other stakeholders, you will play a vital role in handling enquiries, providing accurate information, resolving issues, and ensuring every customer receives a professional and positive experience. Key Responsibilities - Act as the first point of contact for incoming telephone calls and email enquiries. - Provide accurate advice, guidance, and information relating to a range of services and applications. - Resolve customer queries at the first point of contact wherever possible. - Escalate complex enquiries to specialist departments when required, ensuring all relevant information is recorded accurately. - Process customer payments securely via debit and credit card transactions. - Maintain accurate records across multiple IT systems and databases. - Investigate and review customer enquiries using various computer systems to identify the most appropriate resolution. - Support colleagues within the team and provide assistance during periods of high demand. - Handle sensitive information with professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality. - Deliver consistently high standards of customer service while managing customer expectations effectively. What We're Looking For Essential Skills and Experience - Previous experience working within a customer service, contact centre, administration, or call handling environment. - Excellent telephone communication and interpersonal skills. - Experience dealing with challenging, sensitive, or complex customer enquiries. - Strong administrative and data entry skills with excellent attention to detail. - Ability to work confidently across multiple computer systems simultaneously. - Experience maintaining accurate records and managing customer information. - Ability to work independently and use initiative when resolving issues. - Strong organisational and problem-solving skills. Qualifications - GCSEs (or equivalent) including English and Maths, or relevant work experience demonstrating a comparable level of competency. Personal Qualities We are looking for someone who: - Has excellent communication and listening skills. - Demonstrates empathy, professionalism, and patience. - Takes ownership of customer enquiries and follows them through to resolution. - Works collaboratively within a team environment. - Remains calm and professional under pressure. - Is committed to delivering exceptional customer service. Apply Today If you have a passion for customer service, enjoy helping people, and are looking for a rewarding opportunity within a professional organisation, we'd love to hear from you. Submit your CV today for immediate consideration. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, if you do not hear from us within 7 working days, your application has been unsuccessful. If this role is not for you but you do know somebody who would be interested, please feel free to refer them to us! We have a "Refer A Friend" bonus scheme and we will reward you retail vouchers for any referrals who are not already known to us and are successfully placed! title: Customer Service Advisor
company: South West Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description: Customer Service Consultant - Charity Support Location: Ringwood, Hampshire, hybrid working once fully trained Job Type: Temporary to Permanent Salary:£12.80 per hour Permanent Salary:£26,624 per annum Bonus:On-target bonus of £2,400 per annum Hours:Monday to Friday, 9.00am - 5.00pm We are recruiting for a Customer Service Consultant to join a busy customer contact centre based in Ringwood, supporting a major UK charity and its national fundraising campaign. This is a temporary-to-permanent opportunity, initially paying £12.80 per hour. The role will initially be office-based in Ringwood while you complete your training and become fully established in the position. Once fully trained, there may be the opportunity to work on a hybrid basis, combining office and home working. This is a particularly rewarding customer service role where you will be supporting members of the public who are organising fundraising events to raise money for people affected by serious illness. The Role As a Customer Service Consultant, you will be the first point of contact for supporters taking part in a major national fundraising campaign. You will provide friendly, professional and empathetic support across telephone and email, helping people throughout their fundraising journey. Your duties will include: - Handling inbound telephone calls from supporters. - Responding to customer enquiries by email. - Helping supporters register for fundraising events. - Assisting with orders for fundraising materials and information packs. - Providing guidance on paying in money raised through fundraising activities. - Assisting with online fundraising page enquiries. - Making outbound calls where required to follow up queries or provide additional support. - Recording information accurately on internal systems. - Adapting your communication style depending on the individual and nature of their enquiry. - Handling potentially sensitive or emotional conversations with compassion and professionalism. - Working towards individual and team service, quality and performance targets. The Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who has: - Previous experience within customer service, contact centre, retail, hospitality or another customer-focused environment. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. - Strong spelling, grammar and attention to detail. - A friendly and professional telephone manner. - A naturally patient, empathetic and understanding approach. - The confidence to handle sensitive or emotional conversations appropriately. - Good listening and problem-solving skills. - Good typing and general IT skills. - The ability to navigate different computer systems whilst speaking with customers. - Good Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel and Outlook. - The ability to remain organised and professional within a busy customer service environment. Previous experience within a charity, fundraising, contact centre or sensitive customer service environment would be advantageous but is not essential. What's on Offer - £12.80 per hour during the temporary period. - Opportunity to secure a permanent position. - Permanent salary of £26,624 per annum. - On-target bonus of £2,400 per annum. - Excellent Monday to Friday, 9.00am - 5.00pm working hours. - Comprehensive training before handling live customer contacts. - Potential for hybrid working once fully trained. - Ongoing coaching, training and support. - A rewarding role supporting an important national fundraising campaign. - Friendly and supportive team environment. To apply for this opportunity, please submit your latest CV and we will be in touch in due course. If you would like further information before applying, please contact Alan for a confidential discussion.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Our clients Customer Service team plays a vital role in delivering an outstanding experience to customers. As a Customer Service Advisor within the Banking division, you will be the first point of contact for customers, helping to resolve a wide range of queries and providing support across multiple communication channels. This is a varied and fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of customer issues, contribute ideas for service improvements, and make a genuine difference to the customer experience. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about helping others and committed to delivering exceptional service. Salary: Up To £28,000 FTE, £24,000 per annum for a 30 hr contract Working Hours: You will be required to work on a shift rotation basis of 5 days across Monday to Sunday Candidates would be expected to work rotation shifts across the following hours: 7am-3.30pm, 8.30am-5pm, 9am-5.30pm and 11.30am-8pm Key Responsibilities - Deliver excellent customer service via telephone, email, live chat, and social media channels. - Take ownership of customer enquiries and provide effective solutions in a timely manner. - Maintain high standards of service and continuously seek ways to improve the customer experience. - Handle customer complaints professionally and escalate issues where appropriate. - Support continuous improvement initiatives within the customer service function. - Identify opportunities to improve processes, procedures, and workflows. - Work collaboratively within a dynamic and supportive team environment. About You - Previous customer service experience is essential. - Contact centre experience is beneficial but not required. - Confident communicating with customers across a range of channels, particularly by telephone. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. - Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly. - Resilient and able to manage challenging customer interactions with professionalism and empathy. - Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset. - Competent IT skills and confidence using multiple systems and applications.
